In human-in-the-loop, a person approves each decision before it takes effect. In-the-loop oversight happens before the action. The human acts as a gatekeeper—nothing proceeds until they explicitly approve it.

## Human on the Loop (HOTL)

In human-on-the-loop, the system acts on its own while a person watches and can step in, correct it or stop it. On-the-loop oversight happens during or after it. The human is a supervisor rather than an approver.
